In this scenario, we will craft a narrative that subtly highlights the flaws and shortcomings of the Arabic Masjid Palace Center 3D model, while still acknowledging some of its potential uses.
Once upon a time, in a world where digital creations were becoming increasingly common, a group of designers set out to create a 3D model of the Arabic Masjid Palace Center. They aimed to make it suitable for various 3D software and 3D printing applications, ensuring its compatibility with a wide range of devices. The model was designed to have a low poly count, making it easy to edit and maintain a simple, modern aesthetic.
The designers wanted to capture the essence of a creative and futuristic, yet simple Eastern Islamic style. However, in their pursuit of this vision, they seemed to have overlooked some crucial aspects of the design.
While the 3D model was indeed compatible with multiple formats and software, users soon discovered that the simplicity of the design came at the cost of intricate details and authenticity. The model failed to accurately represent the true essence of an Arabic masjid, as it lacked the rich history, architectural elements, and spiritual significance that define such sacred spaces.
Moreover, the claim that the model was suitable for virtual and augmented reality applications was found to be misleading. When integrated into VR and AR environments, the model appeared out of place and unconvincing, as it failed to capture the immersive experience users would expect from such applications.
Despite these shortcomings, the Arabic Masjid Palace Center 3D model did have some potential uses. For instance, it could serve as a starting point for more experienced designers to build upon and create a more accurate representation of an Arabic masjid. Additionally, it might be useful for educational purposes, allowing students to explore and learn about the basic principles of Islamic architecture.
In conclusion, the Arabic Masjid Palace Center 3D model, while initially promising, turned out to be a deceptive representation of a true masjid. Its simplicity and low poly count, while easy to edit, led to a lack of detail and authenticity. Although it could be used as a learning tool or a foundation for more elaborate designs, it failed to live up to the expectations set by its creators.

Église de St-Joseph du HAVRE. Cette église construite après la Seconde Guerre mondiale par Auguste Perret est classée au patrimoine mondial des monuments historique. Elle fait partie des décors HAVRAIS et est atypique grâce à son architecture, mais également de part ses vitraux somptueux. 
Vous aurez la possibilité, en fonction de votre imprimante, de l'imprimer en plusieurs couleurs. Pour ma part, celle-ci de taille de 17 cm en bi-couleur a été imprimée en 8 heures 30 pour la partie haute et 08 heures pour la base. En mono couleur, comptez moitié moins de temps. 
Possibilité d'installer à votre convenance d'une led à l'intérieur. Partie haute et basse peuvent ainsi s'illuminer.

texture size: 1024x1024
texture formats: tga, png

Low-poly tree designed after an American Hornbeam (Carpinus Caroliniana) modeled in Maya 2013. This tree is modeled roughly to scale at 6.68 meters, sized after those typically found in city or urban settings. Model is fully UV'ed and textured, and care has been taken to keep the poly count as low as possible while still maintaining a balance between performance and accuracy.

This model has been organized to ensure users can easily modify the branch count and form to their liking. Everything follows a simple naming convention, and based on model format sections of the tree been placed in appropriate parent hierarchies grouped by leaf/branch types, as well as being layered and color-coded for easy distinction.

Pivots have been placed appropriately, transformations have been frozen and tree01 has been centered at the grid origin. Model comes render-ready (mental ray plug-in required) in .ma and .mb formats with both styles of tree set up, as shown in the item renders.

Textures provided are 1024x1024, and include a summer and autumn-colored texture, both in .png and .tga formats with alpha channels.

Rendered in Maya/mental ray and UDK.

A set of 18 rocks (9 pebbles, 9 stones) 3D Models; 18 individual objects sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, and non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.

For Blender

Blender (Evee) format  and UE4 Asset  are with Full Shading Network (Just put a HDR Texture in the world material Or the Background )

description_text:
Highly realistic 3D models of Feather Reed Grass 'Karl Foerster' - Calamagrostis acutiflora for architectural visualization made in 3dsmax and V-Ray.I decided to make three variations of three different sizes (low, medium, high) and that makes 9 unique grass models. These ornamental grasses provide amazing texture, form and elegance to the landscape. You can pretty much use it in every project because it looks great in a lot of different scenarios and it works well with any architecture style.
Naming I used is as follows: L for Low, M for Medium and H for High, v is for variation. V03’s will be best for planting separately or in places where vertical interest is needed. Try to use it as a border, a vertical accent in places where the bright upper part will stand out against darker background. V01’s  and V02’s are best suitable if You want to make clusters or masses of grass which create the effect of a ‘sea in motion’.
Includes:
● 9 unique grass models - 3dsmax 2014 files
● Fbx export
● Obj export
● 4K Textures
● V-ray materials (vray 3.6)
High grasses - 1235 K tris
Medium grasses - 944 K tris 
Low grasses - 525 K tris
  - Images of grasses in 'real scenes' are for presentation purposes, the scenes are NOT part of the package, just feather reed grass models.

description_text:
Animated with a liquid simulator, 10 seconds of realistically flowing fountain water, shooting upwards then falling to the ground with splashes.
This is an ALEMBIC file. Also enclosed a 3ds max scene file, but you need to browse for the alembic file there.
An OBJ and FBX files are also attached but they are only a still frame of the fountain water flow.
You can drag and drop to any scenes into your 3d application which accepts .acb files.
All the major 3d applications supports .abc files, here is a list of 3d applications which supports .abc files:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alembic_(computer_graphics)
Apply any material, there are several examples in the previews, rendered in vray, but you can render it in any engine with any materials.
You can set a custom timeframe, or you can just use it as a still frame. If you have any questions, let me know.
Thank you, sincerely yours, Motionblur Studios Team

description_text:
Sci-Fi architecture model, and Unreal Engine (UE 4.25) asset.
Unpack folder SciFiAssets to Your UE4 project's Content folder. All materials are set for asset, and there is simple demo level with 3 buildings placed (same model).
Collisions are simplified, but not auto, collisions are placed by hand.
There are NO insides in this building, just exterior.  Helipad on top.
Scale of building is realistic to UE4 3rd person character.
Number 117 is a decal, can be removed, changed.
Model is imported as one piece, but, if you wish you can re-import with support frames and pipes separate. Of course, there is also source .BLEND file, so you can edit and change it further.
Low-poly, game ready Sci-Fi building model. 
Both BLEND and FBX files are saved with textures included.

description_text:
SciFi Info Pillar Console
This file contains the console only. The humanoid models and the background in the image are for demonstration purposes.
Information is an abstract concept that refers to that which has the power to inform. At the most fundamental level information pertains to the interpretation of that which may be sensed. Any natural process that is not completely random and any observable pattern in any medium can be said to convey some amount of information. Whereas digital signals and other data use discrete signs to convey information, other phenomena and artifacts such as analog signals, poems, pictures, music, or other sounds, and currents convey information in a more continuous form. Information is not knowledge itself, but the meaning that may be derived from a representation through interpretation.
Information is often processed iteratively: Data available at one step are processed into information to be interpreted and processed at the next step. For example, in written text each symbol or letter conveys information relevant to the word it is part of, each word conveys information relevant to the phrase it is part of, each phrase conveys information relevant to the sentence it is part of, and so on until at the final step information is interpreted and becomes knowledge in a given domain. In a digital signal bits may be interpreted into the symbols, letters, numbers, or structures that convey the information available at the next level up. The key characteristic of information is that it is subject to interpretation and processing.
The concept of information is relevant in various contexts, including those of constraint, communication, control, data, form, education, knowledge, meaning, understanding, mental stimuli, pattern, perception, proposition, representation, and entropy.
The derivation of information from a signal or message may be thought of as the resolution of ambiguity or uncertainty that arises during the interpretation of patterns within the signal or message.
Information may be structured as data. Redundant data can be compressed up to an optimal size, which is the theoretical limit of compression.
The information available through a collection of data may be derived by analysis. For example, data may be collected from a single customer's order at a restaurant. The information available from many orders may be analyzed, and then becomes knowledge that is put to use when the business subsequently is able to identify the most popular or least popular dish.
Information can be transmitted in time, via data storage, and space, via communication and telecommunication. Information is expressed either as the content of a message or through direct or indirect observation. That which is perceived can be construed as a message in its own right, and in that sense, all information is always conveyed as the content of a message.
Information can be encoded into various forms for transmission and interpretation (for example, information may be encoded into a sequence of signs, or transmitted via a signal). It can also be encrypted for safe storage and communication.

Cartoon Rock Pack is a high quality model to add more details and realism to your rendering projects. Fully detailed, textured model. Detailed enough for close-up renders. Comes with detailed textures. Originally modelled in cinema 4d 17, Final images rendered with marmoset toolbag 3 no postproduction used. Studio light and camera are included in marmoset file.

High quality polygonal model correctly scaled accurate representation of the original objects. Model resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. Model is built to real-world scale . All colors can be easily modified. Model is fully textured with all materials applied. All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format. No cleaning up necessary, just drop model into your scene and start rendering. No special plugin needed to open scene.

Every model has been checked with the appropriate software.
Hope you like it!

Warning !!!. This is not the complete set. You will need to download several more parts to complete this diroram or go here to download everything:

One of the most epic scenes in the Star Wars movies is the entrance of the Cantina. This is set 1 the outside entrance of the cantina on Mos Eisly. Where Obi-Wan and Luke try to find a ship that can take them ot Alderan. This set is very simple to build and can be extened with lights so it lights up the sign like in the Star Wars Series The Mandalorian.
This Set is made for 
  - 1:6  scale (12 inch Hottoys figures)
This is Set includes

  - The Blender file

  - Build instructions 
  - With Print instruction for layer height for each part

  - Paint guide for all parts 

  - Assembly instructions

  - Building instructions Light your set

  - Different file formats for printing 
  - STL 

  - OBJ 

  - Also available in scales on other pages
  - 1:6 

  - 1:12 

  - 1:18 Walls can be 3D printed, or printed on paper like the floor, to fit any size of display

If you send us a message I will send you the build instructions for free, so you can see what you need to create this set.
If you do not have an 3D printer, please contact us, to see our print service.

description_text:
This is model of sci-fi skyscraper with overground metro station and hover train. Model is not ready for subdivision. Easy to use with only 1 material for train and 2 materials for skyscraper with station.
___________ SCENE INFO _____________
This scene contains 4 separate mesh objects: Skyscraper: 35.8K faces, 2 materials, 4 textures.Skyscraper2: 24.4K faces, 2 materials, 4 textures.Metro: 12.K faces, 1 material, 3 textures.Metro2: 12.K faces, 1 material, 3 textures.
Skyscraper and skyscraper2 share same 4 textures.Metro and metro2 share same 3 textures.
Cameras included only in BLEND format.
___________ TEXTURES _____________
7 PNG textures in pack.3 textures in 4096x4096 resolution (diffuse, glossy & emission map for skyscraper).3 textures in 2048x2048 resolution (diffuse, glossy & emission map for metro train).1 texture in 1024x1024 resolution (diffuse map for metro station glass).
ATTENTION: HDRI map used in Blender Cycles renderer is not included in this product.OBJ format: Use attached MTL file to load materials & textures correctly.

3D Model of Day/Night Office Building
Can be used in Real-time, mobile games, VR/AR, Game Engines, Visualization projects.
Optimized for medium and far views. Perfect as a background building or top view.
PBR Textures
3d model has 3 MatID:

  - Facade_white - color, roughness 512x512px

  - Black_frames - color, roughness 512x512px

  - Windows - color, roughness, bump, normal, Self-Illumination (Emissive) Day and Night 2048x2048px

Technical details:

  - Single mesh without holes and n-gons

  - Clean topology

  - Overlapped UV map for better optimization

  - 2nd UV Channel unwrapped without overlappings for lightmap baking in game engines

  - Real-world scale, height - 182,5 meters

  - Scene Units - centimeters. 

Preview images created in Marmoset Toolbag 4, Corona, V-Ray (see watermarks). No post-processing or color correction
3Ds max scene has 2 Physical Materials for Day or Night rendering
Visit my profile to see more 3d models of apartment and office buildings
If you have any questions feel free to contact me. If you like the model don't forget to rate it

description_text:
Carefully crafted pack of low poly buildings and assets for mobile games in 8-bit style.
Pack Contents

  - 12 fully-textured buildings with modifier-adjustable count of floors, and special shader randomly distributing glowing windows.

  - 24 hand-painted neon banners for all kinds of business, and 6 different neon trim lines for decoration.

  - Over 30 building blocks for all kinds of roads, bridges, parking lots, highways, road blocks, and 3 different ground surface tiles (dirt, snow, grass).

  - Over 50 easily distinguishable road signs, traffic lights with emission texture, sign posts, and numbers to recombine speed limit signs.

  - Over 30 interchangeable pieces of roofing and facade decors, helipads, 5G antennas, solar panels, lamp posts, banner plates, roof entrances.

  - Over 10 fencing and framework pieces with Array modifiers to easily change their length and height.

Textures
Pack contains five 512 x 512 textures:

  - City tiles texture - walls (8 different colors), roofing (9 types), decors, doors (9 types x 3 colors), windows (5 types x 3 colors x clear/glass/shattered), 4 types of fencing, metal rails, metal plates, etc.

  - City tiles alpha - with transparency data for fencing and ladders.

  - City tiles emission - for glowing windows, landing marks, traffic lights, light beacons.

  - Banners texture - all kinds of banners.

  - Road tiles texture - 3 ground types (snow, dirt, grass), road lines (20 types), road curbs, sidewalks, stone panels, road borders, manholes, road signs, etc.

Not all tiles were used directly on the buildings or decors, so you can find even more variations in texture files.

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of Cleaning Machine (or so called Walk Behind Scrubber Drier machine).
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
This way it is also good enough for close-ups. The model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with correct geometry. 
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 3092 Triangles

  - 1760 Polygons

  - 1840 Vertices

  - Model is correctly divided into parts to suit the animation process.

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit the animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - Blender files and example render scenes (Eevee studio setup and Cycles HDRI)

  - Blender files in 2 versions (packed and regular-unpacked)

  - Unity3D 2018.4 (.unitypackage)

  - Unreal Engine 4.27 (.uasset)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - 3ds Max 2018 (.max)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Additional Info:

  - Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information about this 3d model.
I will try to write back as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

  - Please also contact me if there are any problems after purchase. We will try to solve the problem together ;)

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

description_text:
Crowd control street barrier 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 38784 vertices, 38816 quad faces (77632 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Wire fence module 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.

Bee3dd is a team who making 3d model best quality, you don't need worry when use our models. We take care to build the smallest detail in the model to ensure the best results. These things are not in others.Our slogan is: best quality - best price!

  - No isolated vertices

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Textures highquality, enough for close-up render ( 2048-4096 pixels )

description_text:
Red velvet rope 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 14504 vertices, 14448 quad faces (28768 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Concrete road barrier 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 704 vertices, 702 quad faces (1404 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

High-quality PBR Low-Poly 3d model of Vintage Post Box.
This object is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with all required PBR textures.
This model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with correct geometry.
PBR texture sets are very detailed so it makes this model good enough for a close-up.  
Technical details:

  - 1 Main body PBR textures set

  - 1871 Triangles.

  - 1836  Vertices.

  - Model is one mesh.

  - Model is real-worldcompletely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot point centered at world origin.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials, and textures are appropriately named.

PBR Texture sets details:
  - 4096 x 4096 PBR Body texture set (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion).
Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

description_text:
High-quality PBR Low-Poly 3d model of Portable Power Generator.
This object is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with all required PBR textures.
This model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with correct geometry.
PBR texture sets are very detailed so it makes this model good enough for a close-up.   
Technical details:

  - 2 PBR textures sets.

  - 4401 Triangles.

  - 5853  Vertices.

  - The model is divided into 3 objects (Main Body, Wheel Front, Wheel Rear).

  - Model is completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot point centered at world origin.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

PBR Texture sets details:

  - 4096x4096 PBR Base texture set (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion).

  - 2048x2048 PBR Wheel texture set  (Albedo, Metallic, Smoothness, Normal, Ambient Occlusion).

Available file formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 (.max)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - Blender 2.82 (.blend | Cycles)

  - Unity3d 2017.3 (.unitypackage)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

description_text:
Low poly 3D model of a New York City Building for using in games and realtime applications.
It can be also used for rendering at medium and far distances.

  - 1 Model for building is provided in OBJ and FBX file format. 

  - The model is perfect for use in games or in realtime projects. 

  - MTL file for OBJ file format material. 

  - PBR ready textures (normal+roughness+metalness) 

  - Windows emission texture for use in night scenes

Textures:

  - 1 2048x2048 diffuse texture 

  - 1 2048x2048 normal texture 

  - 1 2048x2048 occlusion texture 

  - 1 2048x2048 metalness texture 

  - 1 2048x2048 roughness texture 

  - 1 2048x2048 emission texture

OBJ includes a basic .MTL for preview only; no ready-made materials are provided—please create them in your DCC/engine using the supplied PBR textures.
